predictions.rationale: Defines the Order aggregate root with state, behaviors, and status transitions—core implementation of the ordering feature.
Public REST API that creates, cancels, ships and queries orders; entry-point for checkout and order-tracking actions.
Application command handler that executes order creation at checkout, persisting the new Order aggregate.
Implements business logic to cancel an existing order, directly supporting the cancellation aspect of the feature.
Repository that loads and stores Order aggregates; fundamental persistence support for all order operations.
Handles transition to Stock-Confirmed status after inventory validation, a key step in order processing.
Updates orders to Paid status once payment succeeds, covering the payment-tracking portion of the feature.
Executes shipment initiation and sets order to Shipped, fulfilling the shipping aspect of order lifecycle.
Enumeration of all possible order statuses (submitted, paid, shipped, cancelled, etc.) enabling lifecycle tracking.
Provides read-model queries returning current order details and status, supporting order tracking functionality.
